semantic_body_selection_policy_v1.description: Selects HTML-derived semantic text only when sanitized plain text is empty or is a short gateway/notice stub and HTML is materially richer.

semantic_llm_style_policy_v1.description: Versioned stylistic observation policy. Style never supplies threat evidence or promotion authority.

semantic_text_classifier_policy_v1.description: Switch for the compiled local text classifier. mode=shadow records the probability and outcome in details without changing the module result; mode=review lets a positive result raise a review-only Low (omitted mode means review). Shipped in shadow mode because the model still flags a large share of benign notices outside its training data (see semantic/README.md). The weights ship with the engine and are not edited here.

semantic_attachment_policy_v1.description: Switch for analyzing extracted attachment text with the semantic relation rules. mode=score lets attachment relations raise the module result; mode=shadow runs the same analysis and records it in details only (omitted mode means score). Set mode to shadow to silence attachment findings without a redeploy, for example if business documents produce false positives. Extraction bounds live in modules/attach_content.rs.
